in_marathi.name: Mananraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Thoughtful, Introspective, Ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mananraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mananraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'manana' (to think, ponder) and 'raj' (ruler, king). This name signifies a deep thinker or philosopher king who contemplates wisdom and rules with thoughtful decisions.
